concepts.label: Corporation
concepts.description: Organization: A business corporation.

concepts.label: CorrectionComment
concepts.description: A [[comment]] that corrects [[CreativeWork]].

concepts.label: Country
concepts.description: A country.

concepts.label: Course
concepts.description: A description of an educational course which may be offered as distinct instances which take place at different times or take place at different locations, or be offered through different media or modes of study. An educational course is a sequence of one or more educational events and/or creative works which aims to build knowledge, competence or ability of learners.

concepts.label: CourseInstance
concepts.description: An instance of a [[Course]] which is distinct from other instances because it is offered at a different time or location or through different media or modes of study or to a specific section of students.

concepts.label: CreateAction
concepts.description: The act of deliberately creating/producing/generating/building a result out of the agent.

concepts.label: CreativeWork
concepts.description: The most generic kind of creative work, including books, movies, photographs, software programs, etc.

concepts.label: CreativeWorkSeason
concepts.description: A media season, e.g. TV, radio, video game etc.

concepts.label: CreativeWorkSeries
concepts.description:
A CreativeWorkSeries in schema.org is a group of related items, typically but not necessarily of the same kind. CreativeWorkSeries are usually organized into some order, often chronological. Unlike [[ItemList]] which is a general purpose data structure for lists of things, the emphasis with CreativeWorkSeries is on published materials (written e.g. books and periodicals, or media such as TV, radio and games).

Specific subtypes are available for describing [[TVSeries]], [[RadioSeries]], [[MovieSeries]], [[BookSeries]], [[Periodical]] and [[VideoGameSeries]]. In each case, the [[hasPart]] / [[isPartOf]] properties can be used to relate the CreativeWorkSeries to its parts. The general CreativeWorkSeries type serves largely just to organize these more specific and practical subtypes.

It is common for properties applicable to an item from the series to be usefully applied to the containing group. Schema.org attempts to anticipate some of these cases, but publishers should be free to apply properties of the series parts to the series as a whole wherever they seem appropriate.

concepts.label: Credential
concepts.description: A credential is a certificate that is used to verify the identity of a person or entity.

concepts.label: Crematorium
concepts.description: A crematorium.

concepts.label: CriticReview
concepts.description: A [[CriticReview]] is a more specialized form of Review written or published by a source that is recognized for its reviewing activities. These can include online columns, travel and food guides, TV and radio shows, blogs and other independent Web sites. [[CriticReview]]s are typically more in-depth and professionally written. For simpler, casually written user/visitor/viewer/customer reviews, it is more appropriate to use the [[UserReview]] type. Review aggregator sites such as Metacritic already separate out the site's user reviews from selected critic reviews that originate from third-party sources.

concepts.label: DanceEvent
concepts.description: Event type: A social dance.

concepts.label: DataCatalog
concepts.description: A collection of datasets.

concepts.label: DataDownload
concepts.description: All or part of a [[Dataset]] in downloadable form.

concepts.label: DataFeedItem
concepts.description: A single item within a larger data feed.

concepts.label: Dataset
concepts.description: A body of structured information describing some topic(s) of interest.

concepts.label: DatedMoneySpecification
concepts.description: A DatedMoneySpecification represents monetary values with optional start and end dates. For example, this could represent an employee's salary over a specific period of time. __Note:__ This type has been superseded by [[MonetaryAmount]], use of that type is recommended.

concepts.label: DeactivateAction
concepts.description: The act of stopping or deactivating a device or application (e.g. stopping a timer or turning off a flashlight).

concepts.label: DeclarationOfConformity
concepts.description: A Declaration of Conformity (DoC), a formal document issued by a manufacturer declaring that a product meets specific regulatory requirements.

concepts.label: DefinedRegion
concepts.description:
A DefinedRegion is a geographic area defined by potentially arbitrary (rather than political, administrative or natural geographical) criteria. Properties are provided for defining a region by reference to sets of postal codes.

Examples: a delivery destination when shopping. Region where regional pricing is configured.

Requirement 1:
Country: US
States: "NY", "CA"

Requirement 2:
Country: US
PostalCode Set: { [94000-94585], [97000, 97999], [13000, 13599]}
{ [12345, 12345], [78945, 78945], }
Region = state, canton, prefecture, autonomous community...

concepts.label: DefinedTerm
concepts.description: A word, name, acronym, phrase, etc. with a formal definition. Often used in the context of category or subject classification, glossaries or dictionaries, product or creative work types, etc. Use the name property for the term being defined, use termCode if the term has an alpha-numeric code allocated, use description to provide the definition of the term. Use the about property to specify what the term is about.

concepts.label: DefinedTermSet
concepts.description: A set of defined terms, for example a set of categories or a classification scheme, a glossary, dictionary or enumeration. Use the about property to specify what the term set is about.

concepts.label: DeliveryEvent
concepts.description: An event involving the delivery of an item.

concepts.label: DeliveryTimeSettings
concepts.description: A DeliveryTimeSettings represents re-usable pieces of shipping information, relating to timing. It is designed for publication on an URL that may be referenced via the [[shippingSettingsLink]] property of an [[OfferShippingDetails]]. Several occurrences can be published, distinguished (and identified/referenced) by their different values for [[transitTimeLabel]].

concepts.label: Demand
concepts.description: A demand entity represents the public, not necessarily binding, not necessarily exclusive, announcement by an organization or person to seek a certain type of goods or services. For describing demand using this type, the very same properties used for Offer apply.

concepts.label: Dentist
concepts.description: A dentist.

concepts.label: DepartmentStore
concepts.description: A department store.

concepts.label: Diet
concepts.description: A strategy of regulating the intake of food to achieve or maintain a specific health-related goal.

concepts.label: DietarySupplement
concepts.description: A product taken by mouth that contains a dietary ingredient intended to supplement the diet. Dietary ingredients may include vitamins, minerals, herbs or other botanicals, amino acids, and substances such as enzymes, organ tissues, glandulars and metabolites.

concepts.label: DigitalDocument
concepts.description: An electronic file or document.

concepts.label: DigitalDocumentPermission
concepts.description: A permission for a particular person or group to access a particular file.

concepts.label: DigitalProductPassport
concepts.description: A digital product passport (DPP), a record containing information about a product's lifecycle, sustainability, and compliance.

concepts.label: DiscussionForumPosting
concepts.description: A posting to a discussion forum.

concepts.label: Distillery
concepts.description: A distillery.

concepts.label: DrawAction
concepts.description: The act of producing a visual/graphical representation of an object, typically with a pen/pencil and paper as instruments.

concepts.label: Drawing
concepts.description: A picture or diagram made with a pencil, pen, or crayon rather than paint.

concepts.label: DrinkAction
concepts.description: The act of swallowing liquids.

concepts.label: Drug
concepts.description: A chemical or biologic substance, used as a medical therapy, that has a physiological effect on an organism. Here the term drug is used interchangeably with the term medicine although clinical knowledge makes a clear difference between them.

concepts.label: DryCleaningOrLaundry
concepts.description: A dry-cleaning business.

concepts.label: EatAction
concepts.description: The act of swallowing solid objects.

concepts.label: EducationEvent
concepts.description: Event type: Education event.

concepts.label: EducationalAudience
concepts.description: An EducationalAudience.

concepts.label: EducationalOccupationalCredential
concepts.description: An educational or occupational credential. A diploma, academic degree, certification, qualification, badge, etc., that may be awarded to a person or other entity that meets the requirements defined by the credentialer.

concepts.label: EducationalOccupationalProgram
concepts.description: A program offered by an institution which determines the learning progress to achieve an outcome, usually a credential like a degree or certificate. This would define a discrete set of opportunities (e.g., job, courses) that together constitute a program with a clear start, end, set of requirements, and transition to a new occupational opportunity (e.g., a job), or sometimes a higher educational opportunity (e.g., an advanced degree).

concepts.label: EducationalOrganization
concepts.description: An educational organization.

concepts.label: ElectronicsStore
concepts.description: An electronics store.

concepts.label: ElementarySchool
concepts.description: An elementary school.

concepts.label: EmergencyService
concepts.description: An emergency service, such as a fire station or ER.

concepts.label: EmployerAggregateRating
concepts.description: An aggregate rating of an Organization related to its role as an employer.

concepts.label: EmployerReview
concepts.description: An [[EmployerReview]] is a review of an [[Organization]] regarding its role as an employer, written by a current or former employee of that organization.

concepts.label: EmploymentAgency
concepts.description: An employment agency.

concepts.label: EndorsementRating
concepts.description:
An EndorsementRating is a rating that expresses some level of endorsement, for example inclusion in a "critic's pick" blog, a
"Like" or "+1" on a social network. It can be considered the [[result]] of an [[EndorseAction]] in which the [[object]] of the action is rated positively by
some [[agent]]. As is common elsewhere in schema.org, it is sometimes more useful to describe the results of such an action without explicitly describing the [[Action]].

An [[EndorsementRating]] may be part of a numeric scale or organized system, but this is not required: having an explicit type for indicating a positive,
endorsement rating is particularly useful in the absence of numeric scales as it helps consumers understand that the rating is broadly positive.

concepts.label: EnergyConsumptionDetails
concepts.description: EnergyConsumptionDetails represents information related to the energy efficiency of a product that consumes energy. The information that can be provided is based on international regulations such as for example [EU directive 2017/1369](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2017/1369/oj) for energy labeling and the [Energy labeling rule](https://www.ftc.gov/enforcement/rules/rulemaking-regulatory-reform-proceedings/energy-water-use-labeling-consumer) under the Energy Policy and Conservation Act (EPCA) in the US.

concepts.label: EngineSpecification
concepts.description: Information about the engine of the vehicle. A vehicle can have multiple engines represented by multiple engine specification entities.

concepts.label: EntertainmentBusiness
concepts.description: A business providing entertainment.

concepts.label: EntryPoint
concepts.description: An entry point, within some Web-based protocol.

concepts.label: Enumeration
concepts.description: Lists or enumerations—for example, a list of cuisines or music genres, etc.

concepts.label: EnvironmentalProductDeclaration
concepts.description: An Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) that quantifies environmental information on the life cycle of a product.

concepts.label: Episode
concepts.description: A media episode (e.g. TV, radio, video game) which can be part of a series or season.

concepts.label: Event
concepts.description: An event happening at a certain time and location, such as a concert, lecture, or festival. Ticketing information may be added via the [[offers]] property. Repeated events may be structured as separate Event objects.

concepts.label: EventAttendanceModeEnumeration
concepts.description: An EventAttendanceModeEnumeration value is one of potentially several modes of organising an event, relating to whether it is online or offline.

concepts.label: EventSeries
concepts.description:
A series of [[Event]]s. Included events can relate with the series using the [[superEvent]] property.

An EventSeries is a collection of events that share some unifying characteristic. For example, "The Olympic Games" is a series, which
is repeated regularly. The "2012 London Olympics" can be presented both as an [[Event]] in the series "Olympic Games", and as an
[[EventSeries]] that included a number of sporting competitions as Events.

The nature of the association between the events in an [[EventSeries]] can vary, but typical examples could
include a thematic event series (e.g. topical meetups or classes), or a series of regular events that share a location, attendee group and/or organizers.

EventSeries has been defined as a kind of Event to make it easy for publishers to use it in an Event context without
worrying about which kinds of series are really event-like enough to call an Event. In general an EventSeries
may seem more Event-like when the period of time is compact and when aspects such as location are fixed, but
it may also sometimes prove useful to describe a longer-term series as an Event.

concepts.label: EventVenue
concepts.description: An event venue.

concepts.label: ExchangeRateSpecification
concepts.description: A structured value representing exchange rate.

concepts.label: ExercisePlan
concepts.description: Fitness-related activity designed for a specific health-related purpose, including defined exercise routines as well as activity prescribed by a clinician.

concepts.label: ExhibitionEvent
concepts.description: Event type: Exhibition event, e.g. at a museum, library, archive, tradeshow, ...

concepts.label: FAQPage
concepts.description: A [[FAQPage]] is a [[WebPage]] presenting one or more "[Frequently asked questions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FAQ)" (see also [[QAPage]]).

concepts.label: FastFoodRestaurant
concepts.description: A fast-food restaurant.

concepts.label: Festival
concepts.description: Event type: Festival.

concepts.label: FilmAction
concepts.description: The act of capturing sound and moving images on film, video, or digitally.

concepts.label: FinancialIncentive
concepts.description:
Represents financial incentives for goods/services offered by an organization (or individual).

Typically contains the [[name]] of the incentive, the [[incentivizedItem]], the [[incentiveAmount]], the [[incentiveStatus]], [[incentiveType]], the [[provider]] of the incentive, and [[eligibleWithSupplier]].

Optionally contains criteria on whether the incentive is limited based on [[purchaseType]], [[purchasePriceLimit]], [[incomeLimit]], and the [[qualifiedExpense]].

concepts.label: FinancialService
concepts.description: Financial services business.

concepts.label: FindAction
concepts.description:
The act of finding an object.

Related actions:

* [[SearchAction]]: FindAction is generally lead by a SearchAction, but not necessarily.

concepts.label: FireStation
concepts.description: A fire station. With firemen.

concepts.label: FloorPlan
concepts.description: A FloorPlan is an explicit representation of a collection of similar accommodations, allowing the provision of common information (room counts, sizes, layout diagrams) and offers for rental or sale. In typical use, some [[ApartmentComplex]] has an [[accommodationFloorPlan]] which is a [[FloorPlan]].  A FloorPlan is always in the context of a particular place, either a larger [[ApartmentComplex]] or a single [[Apartment]]. The visual/spatial aspects of a floor plan (i.e. room layout, [see wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floor_plan)) can be indicated using [[image]].

concepts.label: Florist
concepts.description: A florist.

concepts.label: FoodEstablishment
concepts.description: A food-related business.

concepts.label: FoodEvent
concepts.description: Event type: Food event.

concepts.label: FulfillmentTypeEnumeration
concepts.description: A type of product fulfillment.

concepts.label: FundingScheme
concepts.description:
A FundingScheme combines organizational, project and policy aspects of grant-based funding
    that sets guidelines, principles and mechanisms to support other kinds of projects and activities.
    Funding is typically organized via [[Grant]] funding. Examples of funding schemes: Swiss Priority Programmes (SPPs); EU Framework 7 (FP7); Horizon 2020; the NIH-R01 Grant Program; Wellcome institutional strategic support fund. For large scale public sector funding, the management and administration of grant awards is often handled by other, dedicated, organizations - [[FundingAgency]]s such as ERC, REA, ...

concepts.label: FurnitureStore
concepts.description: A furniture store.

concepts.label: Game
concepts.description: The Game type represents things which are games. These are typically rule-governed recreational activities, e.g. role-playing games in which players assume the role of characters in a fictional setting.

concepts.label: GameAvailabilityEnumeration
concepts.description: For a [[VideoGame]], such as used with a [[PlayGameAction]], an enumeration of the kind of game availability offered.

concepts.label: GamePlayMode
concepts.description: Indicates whether this game is multi-player, co-op or single-player.

concepts.label: GameServer
concepts.description: Server that provides game interaction in a multiplayer game.

concepts.label: GardenStore
concepts.description: A garden store.

concepts.label: GasStation
concepts.description: A gas station.

concepts.label: GenderType
concepts.description: An enumeration of genders.

concepts.label: Gene
concepts.description: A discrete unit of inheritance which affects one or more biological traits (Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gene)). Examples include FOXP2 (Forkhead box protein P2), SCARNA21 (small Cajal body-specific RNA 21), A- (agouti genotype).

concepts.label: GeoCoordinates
concepts.description: The geographic coordinates of a place or event.

concepts.label: GeoShape
concepts.description: The geographic shape of a place. A GeoShape can be described using several properties whose values are based on latitude/longitude pairs. Either whitespace or commas can be used to separate latitude and longitude; whitespace should be used when writing a list of several such points.

concepts.label: GeospatialGeometry
concepts.description: (Eventually to be defined as) a supertype of GeoShape designed to accommodate definitions from Geo-Spatial best practices.

concepts.label: GovernmentBenefitsType
concepts.description: GovernmentBenefitsType enumerates several kinds of government benefits to support the COVID-19 situation. Note that this structure may not capture all benefits offered.

concepts.label: GovernmentBuilding
concepts.description: A government building.

concepts.label: GovernmentOffice
concepts.description: A government office—for example, an IRS or DMV office.

concepts.label: GovernmentOrganization
concepts.description: A governmental organization or agency.

concepts.label: Grant
concepts.description:
A grant, typically financial or otherwise quantifiable, of resources. Typically a [[funder]] sponsors some [[MonetaryAmount]] to an [[Organization]] or [[Person]],
    sometimes not necessarily via a dedicated or long-lived [[Project]], resulting in one or more outputs, or [[fundedItem]]s. For financial sponsorship, indicate the [[funder]] of a [[MonetaryGrant]]. For non-financial support, indicate [[sponsor]] of [[Grant]]s of resources (e.g. office space).

Grants support  activities directed towards some agreed collective goals, often but not always organized as [[Project]]s. Long-lived projects are sometimes sponsored by a variety of grants over time, but it is also common for a project to be associated with a single grant.

The amount of a [[Grant]] is represented using [[amount]] as a [[MonetaryAmount]].

concepts.label: GroceryStore
concepts.description: A grocery store.

concepts.label: Guide
concepts.description: [[Guide]] is a page or article that recommends specific products or services, or aspects of a thing for a user to consider. A [[Guide]] may represent a Buying Guide and detail aspects of products or services for a user to consider. A [[Guide]] may represent a Product Guide and recommend specific products or services. A [[Guide]] may represent a Ranked List and recommend specific products or services with ranking.

concepts.label: Hackathon
concepts.description: A [hackathon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hackathon) event.

concepts.label: HardwareStore
concepts.description: A hardware store.

concepts.label: HealthAndBeautyBusiness
concepts.description: Health and beauty.

concepts.label: HealthAspectEnumeration
concepts.description: HealthAspectEnumeration enumerates several aspects of health content online, each of which might be described using [[hasHealthAspect]] and [[HealthTopicContent]].

concepts.label: HealthClub
concepts.description: A health club.

concepts.label: HealthInsurancePlan
concepts.description: A US-style health insurance plan, including PPOs, EPOs, and HMOs.

concepts.label: HealthPlanCostSharingSpecification
concepts.description: A description of costs to the patient under a given network or formulary.

concepts.label: HealthPlanFormulary
concepts.description: For a given health insurance plan, the specification for costs and coverage of prescription drugs.

concepts.label: HealthPlanNetwork
concepts.description: A US-style health insurance plan network.

concepts.label: HighSchool
concepts.description: A high school.

concepts.label: HobbyShop
concepts.description: A store that sells materials useful or necessary for various hobbies.

concepts.label: HomeAndConstructionBusiness
concepts.description:
A construction business.

A HomeAndConstructionBusiness is a [[LocalBusiness]] that provides services around homes and buildings.

As a [[LocalBusiness]] it can be described as a [[provider]] of one or more [[Service]]\(s).

concepts.label: HomeGoodsStore
concepts.description: A home goods store.

concepts.label: Hospital
concepts.description: A hospital.

concepts.label: Hostel
concepts.description:
A hostel - cheap accommodation, often in shared dormitories.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

concepts.label: Hotel
concepts.description:
A hotel is an establishment that provides lodging paid on a short-term basis (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hotel).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

concepts.label: House
concepts.description: A house is a building or structure that has the ability to be occupied for habitation by humans or other creatures (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House).

concepts.label: HousePainter
concepts.description: A house painting service.

concepts.label: HowTo
concepts.description: Instructions that explain how to achieve a result by performing a sequence of steps.

concepts.label: HowToDirection
concepts.description: A direction indicating a single action to do in the instructions for how to achieve a result.

concepts.label: HowToItem
concepts.description: An item used as either a tool or supply when performing the instructions for how to achieve a result.

concepts.label: HowToSection
concepts.description: A sub-grouping of steps in the instructions for how to achieve a result (e.g. steps for making a pie crust within a pie recipe).

concepts.label: HowToStep
concepts.description: A step in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It is an ordered list with HowToDirection and/or HowToTip items.

concepts.label: HowToSupply
concepts.description: A supply consumed when performing the instructions for how to achieve a result.

concepts.label: HowToTip
concepts.description: An explanation in the instructions for how to achieve a result. It provides supplementary information about a technique, supply, author's preference, etc. It can explain what could be done, or what should not be done, but doesn't specify what should be done (see HowToDirection).

concepts.label: HowToTool
concepts.description: A tool used (but not consumed) when performing instructions for how to achieve a result.

concepts.label: HyperToc
concepts.description: A HyperToc represents a hypertext table of contents for complex media objects, such as [[VideoObject]], [[AudioObject]]. Items in the table of contents are indicated using the [[tocEntry]] property, and typed [[HyperTocEntry]]. For cases where the same larger work is split into multiple files, [[associatedMedia]] can be used on individual [[HyperTocEntry]] items.

concepts.label: HyperTocEntry
concepts.description: A HyperToEntry is an item within a [[HyperToc]], which represents a hypertext table of contents for complex media objects, such as [[VideoObject]], [[AudioObject]]. The media object itself is indicated using [[associatedMedia]]. Each section of interest within that content can be described with a [[HyperTocEntry]], with associated [[startOffset]] and [[endOffset]]. When several entries are all from the same file, [[associatedMedia]] is used on the overarching [[HyperTocEntry]]; if the content has been split into multiple files, they can be referenced using [[associatedMedia]] on each [[HyperTocEntry]].

concepts.label: IceCreamShop
concepts.description: An ice cream shop.

concepts.label: IgnoreAction
concepts.description: The act of intentionally disregarding the object. An agent ignores an object.

concepts.label: ImageObject
concepts.description: An image file.

concepts.label: ImageObjectSnapshot
concepts.description: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of an [[ImageObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata (e.g. XMP, EXIF) the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.

concepts.label: IncentiveQualifiedExpenseType
concepts.description: The types of expenses that are covered by the incentive. For example some incentives are only for the goods (tangible items) but the services (labor) are excluded.

concepts.label: IncentiveStatus
concepts.description: Enumerates a status for an incentive, such as whether it is active.

concepts.label: IncentiveType
concepts.description: Enumerates common financial incentives for products, including tax credits, tax deductions, rebates and subsidies, etc.

concepts.label: IndividualProduct
concepts.description: A single, identifiable product instance (e.g. a laptop with a particular serial number).

concepts.label: InstallAction
concepts.description: The act of installing an application.

concepts.label: InstantaneousEvent
concepts.description: An event with no duration, like for instance a computer log entry.

concepts.label: InsuranceAgency
concepts.description: An Insurance agency.

concepts.label: Intangible
concepts.description: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things such as quantities, structured values, etc.

concepts.label: InteractAction
concepts.description: The act of interacting with another person or organization.

concepts.label: InteractionCounter
concepts.description: A summary of how users have interacted with this CreativeWork. In most cases, authors will use a subtype to specify the specific type of interaction.

concepts.label: InternetCafe
concepts.description: An internet cafe.

concepts.label: Invoice
concepts.description: A statement of the money due for goods or services; a bill.

concepts.label: ItemAvailability
concepts.description: A list of possible product availability options.

concepts.label: ItemList
concepts.description: A list of items of any sort—for example, Top 10 Movies About Weathermen, or Top 100 Party Songs. Not to be confused with HTML lists, which are often used only for formatting.

concepts.label: ItemListOrderType
concepts.description: Enumerated for values for itemListOrder for indicating how an ordered ItemList is organized.

concepts.label: ItemPage
concepts.description: A page devoted to a single item, such as a particular product or hotel.

concepts.label: JewelryStore
concepts.description: A jewelry store.

concepts.label: JobPosting
concepts.description: A listing that describes a job opening in a certain organization.

concepts.label: JoinAction
concepts.description:
An agent joins an event/group with participants/friends at a location.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: Unlike RegisterAction, JoinAction refers to joining a group/team of people.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, JoinAction does not imply that you'll be receiving updates.
* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, JoinAction does not imply that you'll be polling for updates.

concepts.label: Landform
concepts.description: A landform or physical feature.  Landform elements include mountains, plains, lakes, rivers, seascape and oceanic waterbody interface features such as bays, peninsulas, seas and so forth, including sub-aqueous terrain features such as submersed mountain ranges, volcanoes, and the great ocean basins.

concepts.label: LandmarksOrHistoricalBuildings
concepts.description: An historical landmark or building.

concepts.label: Language
concepts.description: Natural languages such as Spanish, Tamil, Hindi, English, etc. Formal language code tags expressed in [BCP 47](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag) can be used via the [[alternateName]] property. The Language type previously also covered programming languages such as Scheme and Lisp, which are now best represented using [[ComputerLanguage]].

concepts.label: LearningResource
concepts.description:
The LearningResource type can be used to indicate [[CreativeWork]]s (whether physical or digital) that have a particular and explicit orientation towards learning, education, skill acquisition, and other educational purposes.

[[LearningResource]] is expected to be used as an addition to a primary type such as [[Book]], [[VideoObject]], [[Product]] etc.

[[EducationEvent]] serves a similar purpose for event-like things (e.g. a [[Trip]]). A [[LearningResource]] may be created as a result of an [[EducationEvent]], for example by recording one.

concepts.label: LeaveAction
concepts.description:
An agent leaves an event / group with participants/friends at a location.

Related actions:

* [[JoinAction]]: The antonym of LeaveAction.
* [[UnRegisterAction]]: Unlike UnRegisterAction, LeaveAction implies leaving a group/team of people rather than a service.

concepts.label: LegalService
concepts.description: A LegalService is a business that provides legally-oriented services, advice and representation, e.g. law firms.\n\nAs a [[LocalBusiness]] it can be described as a [[provider]] of one or more [[Service]]\(s).

concepts.label: LegalValueLevel
concepts.description: A list of possible levels for the legal validity of a legislation.

concepts.label: Legislation
concepts.description: A legal document such as an act, decree, bill, etc. (enforceable or not) or a component of a legal act (like an article).

concepts.label: LegislationObject
concepts.description: A specific object or file containing a Legislation. Note that the same Legislation can be published in multiple files. For example, a digitally signed PDF, a plain PDF and an HTML version.

concepts.label: LegislativeBuilding
concepts.description: A legislative building—for example, the state capitol.

concepts.label: Library
concepts.description: A library.

concepts.label: LibrarySystem
concepts.description: A [[LibrarySystem]] is a collaborative system amongst several libraries.

concepts.label: LiquorStore
concepts.description: A shop that sells alcoholic drinks such as wine, beer, whisky and other spirits.

concepts.label: ListItem
concepts.description: An list item, e.g. a step in a checklist or how-to description.

concepts.label: ListenAction
concepts.description: The act of consuming audio content.

concepts.label: LiteraryEvent
concepts.description: Event type: Literary event.

concepts.label: LiveBlogPosting
concepts.description: A [[LiveBlogPosting]] is a [[BlogPosting]] intended to provide a rolling textual coverage of an ongoing event through continuous updates.

concepts.label: LocalBusiness
concepts.description: A particular physical business or branch of an organization. Examples of LocalBusiness include a restaurant, a particular branch of a restaurant chain, a branch of a bank, a medical practice, a club, a bowling alley, etc.

concepts.label: Locksmith
concepts.description: A locksmith.

concepts.label: LodgingBusiness
concepts.description: A lodging business, such as a motel, hotel, or inn.

concepts.label: LoginAction
concepts.description: The action of logging into a device or application.

concepts.label: LoseAction
concepts.description: The act of being defeated in a competitive activity.

concepts.label: Manuscript
concepts.description: A book, document, or piece of music written by hand rather than typed or printed.

concepts.label: Map
concepts.description: A map.

concepts.label: MapCategoryType
concepts.description: An enumeration of several kinds of Map.

concepts.label: MarryAction
concepts.description: The act of marrying a person.

concepts.label: MathSolver
concepts.description: A math solver which is capable of solving a subset of mathematical problems.

concepts.label: MeasurementMethodEnum
concepts.description: Enumeration(s) for use with [[measurementMethod]].

concepts.label: MeasurementTypeEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumeration of common measurement types (or dimensions), for example "chest" for a person, "inseam" for pants, "gauge" for screws, or "wheel" for bicycles.

concepts.label: MediaEnumeration
concepts.description: MediaEnumeration enumerations are lists of codes, labels etc. useful for describing media objects. They may be reflections of externally developed lists, or created at schema.org, or a combination.

concepts.label: MediaGallery
concepts.description: Web page type: Media gallery page. A mixed-media page that can contain media such as images, videos, and other multimedia.

concepts.label: MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration
concepts.description: Codes for use with the [[mediaAuthenticityCategory]] property, indicating the authenticity of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared). In general these codes are not mutually exclusive, although some combinations (such as 'original' versus 'transformed', 'edited' and 'staged') would be contradictory if applied in the same [[MediaReview]]. Note that the application of these codes is with regard to a piece of media shared or published in a particular context.

concepts.label: MediaObject
concepts.description: A media object, such as an image, video, audio, or text object embedded in a web page or a downloadable dataset i.e. DataDownload. Note that a creative work may have many media objects associated with it on the same web page. For example, a page about a single song (MusicRecording) may have a music video (VideoObject), and a high and low bandwidth audio stream (2 AudioObject's).

concepts.label: MediaReview
concepts.description:
A [[MediaReview]] is a more specialized form of Review dedicated to the evaluation of media content online, typically in the context of fact-checking and misinformation.
    For more general reviews of media in the broader sense, use [[UserReview]], [[CriticReview]] or other [[Review]] types. This definition is
    a work in progress. While the [[MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration]] list reflects significant community review amongst fact-checkers and others working
    to combat misinformation, the specific structures for representing media objects, their versions and publication context, are still evolving. Similarly, best practices for the relationship between [[MediaReview]] and [[ClaimReview]] markup have not yet been finalized.

concepts.label: MediaReviewItem
concepts.description: Represents an item or group of closely related items treated as a unit for the sake of evaluation in a [[MediaReview]]. Authorship etc. apply to the items rather than to the curation/grouping or reviewing party.

concepts.label: MediaSubscription
concepts.description: A subscription which allows a user to access media including audio, video, books, etc.

concepts.label: MedicalAudience
concepts.description: Target audiences for medical web pages.

concepts.label: MedicalBusiness
concepts.description: A particular physical or virtual business of an organization for medical purposes. Examples of MedicalBusiness include different businesses run by health professionals.

concepts.label: MedicalClinic
concepts.description: A facility, often associated with a hospital or medical school, that is devoted to the specific diagnosis and/or healthcare. Previously limited to outpatients but with evolution it may be open to inpatients as well.

concepts.label: MedicalEntity
concepts.description: The most generic type of entity related to health and the practice of medicine.

concepts.label: MedicalEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerations related to health and the practice of medicine: A concept that is used to attribute a quality to another concept, as a qualifier, a collection of items or a listing of all of the elements of a set in medicine practice.

concepts.label: MedicalEvidenceLevel
concepts.description: Level of evidence for a medical guideline. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalGuideline
concepts.description: Any recommendation made by a standard society (e.g. ACC/AHA) or consensus statement that denotes how to diagnose and treat a particular condition. Note: this type should be used to tag the actual guideline recommendation; if the guideline recommendation occurs in a larger scholarly article, use MedicalScholarlyArticle to tag the overall article, not this type. Note also: the organization making the recommendation should be captured in the recognizingAuthority base property of MedicalEntity.

concepts.label: MedicalGuidelineContraindication
concepts.description: A guideline contraindication that designates a process as harmful and where quality of the data supporting the contraindication is sound.

concepts.label: MedicalGuidelineRecommendation
concepts.description: A guideline recommendation that is regarded as efficacious and where quality of the data supporting the recommendation is sound.

concepts.label: MedicalImagingTechnique
concepts.description: Any medical imaging modality typically used for diagnostic purposes. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalIndication
concepts.description: A condition or factor that indicates use of a medical therapy, including signs, symptoms, risk factors, anatomical states, etc.

concepts.label: MedicalIntangible
concepts.description: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things in the medical space.

concepts.label: MedicalObservationalStudyDesign
concepts.description: Design models for observational medical studies. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalOrganization
concepts.description: A medical organization (physical or not), such as hospital, institution or clinic.

concepts.label: MedicalProcedure
concepts.description: A process of care used in either a diagnostic, therapeutic, preventive or palliative capacity that relies on invasive (surgical), non-invasive, or other techniques.

concepts.label: MedicalProcedureType
concepts.description: An enumeration that describes different types of medical procedures.

concepts.label: MedicalRiskEstimator
concepts.description: Any rule set or interactive tool for estimating the risk of developing a complication or condition.

concepts.label: MedicalRiskFactor
concepts.description: A risk factor is anything that increases a person's likelihood of developing or contracting a disease, medical condition, or complication.

concepts.label: MedicalRiskScore
concepts.description: A simple system that adds up the number of risk factors to yield a score that is associated with prognosis, e.g. CHAD score, TIMI risk score.

concepts.label: MedicalSpecialty
concepts.description: Any specific branch of medical science or practice. Medical specialities include clinical specialties that pertain to particular organ systems and their respective disease states, as well as allied health specialties. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalStudy
concepts.description: A medical study is an umbrella type covering all kinds of research studies relating to human medicine or health, including observational studies and interventional trials and registries, randomized, controlled or not. When the specific type of study is known, use one of the extensions of this type, such as MedicalTrial or MedicalObservationalStudy. Also, note that this type should be used to mark up data that describes the study itself; to tag an article that publishes the results of a study, use MedicalScholarlyArticle. Note: use the code property of MedicalEntity to store study IDs, e.g. clinicaltrials.gov ID.

concepts.label: MedicalStudyStatus
concepts.description: The status of a medical study. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalTest
concepts.description: Any medical test, typically performed for diagnostic purposes.

concepts.label: MedicalTestPanel
concepts.description: Any collection of tests commonly ordered together.

concepts.label: MedicalTrial
concepts.description: A medical trial is a type of medical study that uses a scientific process to compare the safety and efficacy of medical therapies or medical procedures. In general, medical trials are controlled and subjects are allocated at random to the different treatment and/or control groups.

concepts.label: MedicalTrialDesign
concepts.description: Design models for medical trials. Enumerated type.

concepts.label: MedicalWebPage
concepts.description: A web page that provides medical information.

concepts.label: MedicineSystem
concepts.description: Systems of medical practice.

concepts.label: MemberProgram
concepts.description: A MemberProgram defines a loyalty (or membership) program that provides its members with certain benefits, for example better pricing, free shipping or returns, or the ability to earn loyalty points. Member programs may have multiple tiers, for example silver and gold members, each with different benefits.

concepts.label: MemberProgramTier
concepts.description: A MemberProgramTier specifies a tier under a loyalty (member) program, for example "gold".

concepts.label: MensClothingStore
concepts.description: A men's clothing store.

concepts.label: Menu
concepts.description: A structured representation of food or drink items available from a FoodEstablishment.

concepts.label: MenuItem
concepts.description: A food or drink item listed in a menu or menu section.

concepts.label: MenuSection
concepts.description: A sub-grouping of food or drink items in a menu. E.g. courses (such as 'Dinner', 'Breakfast', etc.), specific type of dishes (such as 'Meat', 'Vegan', 'Drinks', etc.), or some other classification made by the menu provider.

concepts.label: MerchantReturnEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerates several kinds of product return policies.

concepts.label: MerchantReturnPolicy
concepts.description: A MerchantReturnPolicy provides information about product return policies associated with an [[Organization]], [[Product]], or [[Offer]].

concepts.label: MerchantReturnPolicySeasonalOverride
concepts.description: A seasonal override of a return policy, for example used for holidays.

concepts.label: Message
concepts.description: A single message from a sender to one or more organizations or people.

concepts.label: MiddleSchool
concepts.description: A middle school (typically for children aged around 11-14, although this varies somewhat).

concepts.label: MobileApplication
concepts.description: A software application designed specifically to work well on a mobile device such as a telephone.

concepts.label: MobilePhoneStore
concepts.description: A store that sells mobile phones and related accessories.

concepts.label: MolecularEntity
concepts.description: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity.

concepts.label: MonetaryAmount
concepts.description: A monetary value or range. This type can be used to describe an amount of money such as $50 USD, or a range as in describing a bank account being suitable for a balance between £1,000 and £1,000,000 GBP, or the value of a salary, etc. It is recommended to use [[PriceSpecification]] Types to describe the price of an Offer, Invoice, etc.

concepts.label: MonetaryGrant
concepts.description: A monetary grant.

concepts.label: Motel
concepts.description:
A motel.

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

concepts.label: MotorcycleDealer
concepts.description: A motorcycle dealer.

concepts.label: MotorcycleRepair
concepts.description: A motorcycle repair shop.

concepts.label: Mountain
concepts.description: A mountain, like Mount Whitney or Mount Everest.

concepts.label: MoveAction
concepts.description:
The act of an agent relocating to a place.

Related actions:

* [[TransferAction]]: Unlike TransferAction, the subject of the move is a living Person or Organization rather than an inanimate object.

concepts.label: Movie
concepts.description: A movie.

concepts.label: MovieClip
concepts.description: A short segment/part of a movie.

concepts.label: MovieRentalStore
concepts.description: A movie rental store.

concepts.label: MovieSeries
concepts.description: A series of movies. Included movies can be indicated with the hasPart property.

concepts.label: MovieTheater
concepts.description: A movie theater.

concepts.label: MovingCompany
concepts.description: A moving company.

concepts.label: Museum
concepts.description: A museum.

concepts.label: MusicAlbumProductionType
concepts.description: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

concepts.label: MusicAlbumReleaseType
concepts.description: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

concepts.label: MusicComposition
concepts.description: A musical composition.

concepts.label: MusicEvent
concepts.description: Event type: Music event.

concepts.label: MusicPlaylist
concepts.description: A collection of music tracks in playlist form.

concepts.label: MusicRecording
concepts.description: A music recording (track), usually a single song.

concepts.label: MusicRelease
concepts.description: A MusicRelease is a specific release of a music album.

concepts.label: MusicReleaseFormatType
concepts.description: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

concepts.label: MusicStore
concepts.description: A music store.

concepts.label: MusicVenue
concepts.description: A music venue.

concepts.label: MusicVideoObject
concepts.description: A music video file.

concepts.label: NGO
concepts.description: Organization: Non-governmental Organization.

concepts.label: NailSalon
concepts.description: A nail salon.

concepts.label: NewsArticle
concepts.description:
A NewsArticle is an article whose content reports news, or provides background context and supporting materials for understanding the news.

A more detailed overview of [schema.org News markup](/docs/news.html) is also available.

concepts.label: NewsMediaOrganization
concepts.description: A News/Media organization such as a newspaper or TV station.

concepts.label: NightClub
concepts.description: A nightclub or discotheque.

concepts.label: NonprofitType
concepts.description: NonprofitType enumerates several kinds of official non-profit types of which a non-profit organization can be.

concepts.label: Notary
concepts.description: A notary.

concepts.label: NoteDigitalDocument
concepts.description: A file containing a note, primarily for the author.

concepts.label: NutritionInformation
concepts.description: Nutritional information about the recipe.

concepts.label: Observation
concepts.description:
Instances of the class [[Observation]] are used to specify observations about an entity at a particular time. The principal properties of an [[Observation]] are [[observationAbout]], [[measuredProperty]], [[statType]], [[value] and [[observationDate]]  and [[measuredProperty]]. Some but not all Observations represent a [[QuantitativeValue]]. Quantitative observations can be about a [[StatisticalVariable]], which is an abstract specification about which we can make observations that are grounded at a particular location and time.

Observations can also encode a subset of simple RDF-like statements (its observationAbout, a StatisticalVariable, defining the measuredPoperty; its observationAbout property indicating the entity the statement is about, and [[value]] )

In the context of a quantitative knowledge graph, typical properties could include [[measuredProperty]], [[observationAbout]], [[observationDate]], [[value]], [[unitCode]], [[unitText]], [[measurementMethod]].

concepts.label: Occupation
concepts.description: A profession, may involve prolonged training and/or a formal qualification.

concepts.label: OccupationalExperienceRequirements
concepts.description: Indicates employment-related experience requirements, e.g. [[monthsOfExperience]].

concepts.label: Offer
concepts.description:
An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service — for example, an offer to sell tickets to an event, to rent the DVD of a movie, to stream a TV show over the internet, to repair a motorcycle, or to loan a book.

Note: As the [[businessFunction]] property, which identifies the form of offer (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose), defaults to http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell; an Offer without a defined businessFunction value can be assumed to be an offer to sell.

For [GTIN](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin)-related fields, see [Check Digit calculator](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/support/check_digit_calculator) and [validation guide](http://www.gs1us.org/resources/standards/gtin-validation-guide) from [GS1](http://www.gs1.org/).

concepts.label: OfferCatalog
concepts.description: An OfferCatalog is an ItemList that contains related Offers and/or further OfferCatalogs that are offeredBy the same provider.

concepts.label: OfferForLease
concepts.description:
An [[OfferForLease]] in Schema.org represents an [[Offer]] to lease out something, i.e. an [[Offer]] whose
  [[businessFunction]] is [lease out](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#LeaseOut.). See [Good Relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GoodRelations) for
  background on the underlying concepts.

concepts.label: OfferForPurchase
concepts.description:
An [[OfferForPurchase]] in Schema.org represents an [[Offer]] to sell something, i.e. an [[Offer]] whose
  [[businessFunction]] is [sell](http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.). See [Good Relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GoodRelations) for
  background on the underlying concepts.

concepts.label: OfferItemCondition
concepts.description: A list of possible conditions for the item.

concepts.label: OfferShippingDetails
concepts.description:
OfferShippingDetails represents information about shipping destinations.

Multiple of these entities can be used to represent different shipping rates for different destinations:

One entity for Alaska/Hawaii. A different one for continental US. A different one for all France.

Multiple of these entities can be used to represent different shipping costs and delivery times.

Two entities that are identical but differ in rate and time:

E.g. Cheaper and slower: $5 in 5-7 days
or Fast and expensive: $15 in 1-2 days.

concepts.label: OfficeEquipmentStore
concepts.description: An office equipment store.

concepts.label: OnlineBusiness
concepts.description: A particular online business, either standalone or the online part of a broader organization. Examples include an eCommerce site, an online travel booking site, an online learning site, an online logistics and shipping provider, an online (virtual) doctor, etc.

concepts.label: OnlineStore
concepts.description: An eCommerce site.

concepts.label: OpeningHoursSpecification
concepts.description:
A structured value providing information about the opening hours of a place or a certain service inside a place.


The place is __open__ if the [[opens]] property is specified, and __closed__ otherwise.

If the value for the [[closes]] property is less than the value for the [[opens]] property then the hour range is assumed to span over the next day.

concepts.label: OperatingSystem
concepts.description: System software that manages computer hardware and software resources, and provides common services for computer programs.

concepts.label: OpinionNewsArticle
concepts.description: An [[OpinionNewsArticle]] is a [[NewsArticle]] that primarily expresses opinions rather than journalistic reporting of news and events. For example, a [[NewsArticle]] consisting of a column or [[Blog]]/[[BlogPosting]] entry in the Opinions section of a news publication.

concepts.label: Optician
concepts.description: A store that sells reading glasses and similar devices for improving vision.

concepts.label: Order
concepts.description: An order is a confirmation of a transaction (a receipt), which can contain multiple line items, each represented by an Offer that has been accepted by the customer.

concepts.label: OrderItem
concepts.description: An order item is a line of an order. It includes the quantity and shipping details of a bought offer.

concepts.label: Organization
concepts.description: An organization such as a school, NGO, corporation, club, etc.

concepts.label: OrganizeAction
concepts.description: The act of manipulating/administering/supervising/controlling one or more objects.

concepts.label: OutletStore
concepts.description: An outlet store.

concepts.label: OwnershipInfo
concepts.description: A structured value providing information about when a certain organization or person owned a certain product.

concepts.label: PaintAction
concepts.description: The act of producing a painting, typically with paint and canvas as instruments.

concepts.label: Painting
concepts.description: A painting.

concepts.label: PalliativeProcedure
concepts.description: A medical procedure intended primarily for palliative purposes, aimed at relieving the symptoms of an underlying health condition.

concepts.label: ParcelDelivery
concepts.description: The delivery of a parcel either via the postal service or a commercial service.

concepts.label: Park
concepts.description: A park.

concepts.label: ParkingFacility
concepts.description: A parking lot or other parking facility.

concepts.label: PathologyTest
concepts.description: A medical test performed by a laboratory that typically involves examination of a tissue sample by a pathologist.

concepts.label: Patient
concepts.description: A patient is any person recipient of health care services.

concepts.label: PawnShop
concepts.description: A shop that will buy, or lend money against the security of, personal possessions.

concepts.label: PaymentMethod
concepts.description:
A payment method is a standardized procedure for transferring the monetary amount for a purchase. Payment methods are characterized by the legal and technical structures used, and by the organization or group carrying out the transaction. The following legacy values should be accepted: 

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#ByBankTransferInAdvance
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#ByInvoice
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Cash
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#CheckInAdvance
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#COD
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DirectDebit
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#GoogleCheckout
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PayPal
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PaySwarm

Structured values, or [UNCE payment means](https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/PaymentMeans) are recommended or for newer annotations.

concepts.label: PaymentMethodType
concepts.description: The type of payment method, only for generic payment types, specific forms of payments, like card payment should be expressed using subclasses of PaymentMethod.

concepts.label: PaymentService
concepts.description: A Service to transfer funds from a person or organization to a beneficiary person or organization.

concepts.label: PeopleAudience
concepts.description: A set of characteristics belonging to people, e.g. who compose an item's target audience.

concepts.label: PerformingArtsEvent
concepts.description:
Live performance Event of the performing arts (music, theatre, dance, acrobatics, spoken word), including performance art and performative sports (e.g. choreographed forms of martial arts, figure skating, competitive ballroom dancing).

Note: Use additionalType to differentiate between productions / shows (PerformanceWork, EventSeries), tours (EventSeries), and individual performances.

concepts.label: PerformingArtsTheater
concepts.description: A theater or other performing art center.

concepts.label: PerformingGroup
concepts.description: A performance group, such as a band, an orchestra, or a circus.

concepts.label: Periodical
concepts.description: A publication in any medium issued in successive parts bearing numerical or chronological designations and intended to continue indefinitely, such as a magazine, scholarly journal, or newspaper.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

concepts.label: Permit
concepts.description: A permit issued by an organization, e.g. a parking pass.

concepts.label: Person
concepts.description: A person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).

concepts.label: PetStore
concepts.description: A pet store.

concepts.label: Pharmacy
concepts.description: A pharmacy or drugstore.

concepts.label: Photograph
concepts.description: A photograph.

concepts.label: PhotographAction
concepts.description: The act of capturing still images of objects using a camera.

concepts.label: PhysicalActivityCategory
concepts.description: Categories of physical activity, organized by physiologic classification.

concepts.label: PhysicalExam
concepts.description: A type of physical examination of a patient performed by a physician.

concepts.label: Physician
concepts.description: An individual physician or a physician's office considered as a [[MedicalOrganization]].

concepts.label: PhysiciansOffice
concepts.description: A doctor's office or clinic.

concepts.label: Place
concepts.description: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical extension.

concepts.label: PlaceOfWorship
concepts.description: Place of worship, such as a church, synagogue, or mosque.

concepts.label: PlanAction
concepts.description: The act of planning the execution of an event/task/action/reservation/plan to a future date.

concepts.label: Play
concepts.description: A play is a form of literature, usually consisting of dialogue between characters, intended for theatrical performance rather than just reading. Note: A performance of a Play would be a [[TheaterEvent]] or [[BroadcastEvent]] - the *Play* being the [[workPerformed]].

concepts.label: PlayAction
concepts.description:
The act of playing/exercising/training/performing for enjoyment, leisure, recreation, competition or exercise.

Related actions:

* [[ListenAction]]: Unlike ListenAction (which is under ConsumeAction), PlayAction refers to performing for an audience or at an event, rather than consuming music.
* [[WatchAction]]: Unlike WatchAction (which is under ConsumeAction), PlayAction refers to showing/displaying for an audience or at an event, rather than consuming visual content.

concepts.label: PlayGameAction
concepts.description: The act of playing a video game.

concepts.label: Playground
concepts.description: A playground.

concepts.label: Plumber
concepts.description: A plumbing service.

concepts.label: PodcastEpisode
concepts.description: A single episode of a podcast series.

concepts.label: PodcastSeason
concepts.description: A single season of a podcast. Many podcasts do not break down into separate seasons. In that case, PodcastSeries should be used.

concepts.label: PodcastSeries
concepts.description: A podcast is an episodic series of digital audio or video files which a user can download and listen to.

concepts.label: PoliceStation
concepts.description: A police station.

concepts.label: PoliticalParty
concepts.description: Organization: Political Party.

concepts.label: PostOffice
concepts.description: A post office.

concepts.label: PostalAddress
concepts.description: The mailing address.

concepts.label: PostalCodeRangeSpecification
concepts.description: Indicates a range of postal codes, usually defined as the set of valid codes between [[postalCodeBegin]] and [[postalCodeEnd]], inclusively.

concepts.label: Poster
concepts.description: A large, usually printed placard, bill, or announcement, often illustrated, that is posted to advertise or publicize something.

concepts.label: Preschool
concepts.description: A preschool.

concepts.label: PresentationDigitalDocument
concepts.description: A file containing slides or used for a presentation.

concepts.label: PreventionIndication
concepts.description: An indication for preventing an underlying condition, symptom, etc.

concepts.label: PriceComponentTypeEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerates different price components that together make up the total price for an offered product.

concepts.label: PriceSpecification
concepts.description: A structured value representing a price or price range. Typically, only the subclasses of this type are used for markup. It is recommended to use [[MonetaryAmount]] to describe independent amounts of money such as a salary, credit card limits, etc.

concepts.label: PriceTypeEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerates different price types, for example list price, invoice price, and sale price.

concepts.label: Product
concepts.description: Any offered product or service. For example: a pair of shoes; a concert ticket; the rental of a car; a haircut; or an episode of a TV show streamed online.

concepts.label: ProductCollection
concepts.description: A set of products (either [[ProductGroup]]s or specific variants) that are listed together e.g. in an [[Offer]].

concepts.label: ProductGroup
concepts.description:
A ProductGroup represents a group of [[Product]]s that vary only in certain well-described ways, such as by [[size]], [[color]], [[material]] etc.

While a ProductGroup itself is not directly offered for sale, the various varying products that it represents can be. The ProductGroup serves as a prototype or template, standing in for all of the products who have an [[isVariantOf]] relationship to it. As such, properties (including additional types) can be applied to the ProductGroup to represent characteristics shared by each of the (possibly very many) variants. Properties that reference a ProductGroup are not included in this mechanism; neither are the following specific properties [[variesBy]], [[hasVariant]], [[url]].

concepts.label: ProductModel
concepts.description: A datasheet or vendor specification of a product (in the sense of a prototypical description).

concepts.label: ProductReturnEnumeration
concepts.description: ProductReturnEnumeration enumerates several kinds of product return policy. Note that this structure may not capture all aspects of the policy.

concepts.label: ProductReturnPolicy
concepts.description: A ProductReturnPolicy provides information about product return policies associated with an [[Organization]] or [[Product]].

concepts.label: ProfessionalService
concepts.description:
Original definition: "provider of professional services."\n\nThe general [[ProfessionalService]] type for local businesses was deprecated due to confusion with [[Service]]. For reference, the types that it included were: [[Dentist]],
        [[AccountingService]], [[Attorney]], [[Notary]], as well as types for several kinds of [[HomeAndConstructionBusiness]]: [[Electrician]], [[GeneralContractor]],
        [[HousePainter]], [[Locksmith]], [[Plumber]], [[RoofingContractor]]. [[LegalService]] was introduced as a more inclusive supertype of [[Attorney]].

concepts.label: ProfilePage
concepts.description: Web page type: Profile page.

concepts.label: ProgramMembership
concepts.description: Used to describe membership in a loyalty programs (e.g. "StarAliance"), traveler clubs (e.g. "AAA"), purchase clubs ("Safeway Club"), etc.

concepts.label: Project
concepts.description:
An enterprise (potentially individual but typically collaborative), planned to achieve a particular aim.
Use properties from [[Organization]], [[subOrganization]]/[[parentOrganization]] to indicate project sub-structures.

concepts.label: Property
concepts.description: A property, used to indicate attributes and relationships of some Thing; equivalent to rdf:Property.

concepts.label: PropertyValue
concepts.description: A property-value pair, e.g. representing a feature of a product or place. Use the 'name' property for the name of the property. If there is an additional human-readable version of the value, put that into the 'description' property.\n\n Always use specific schema.org properties when a) they exist and b) you can populate them. Using PropertyValue as a substitute will typically not trigger the same effect as using the original, specific property.

concepts.label: PropertyValueSpecification
concepts.description: A Property value specification.

concepts.label: Protein
concepts.description: Protein is here used in its widest possible definition, as classes of amino acid based molecules. Amyloid-beta Protein in human (UniProt P05067), eukaryota (e.g. an OrthoDB group) or even a single molecule that one can point to are all of type :Protein. A protein can thus be a subclass of another protein, e.g. :Protein as a UniProt record can have multiple isoforms inside it which would also be :Protein. They can be imagined, synthetic, hypothetical or naturally occurring.

concepts.label: PublicToilet
concepts.description: A public toilet is a room or small building containing one or more toilets (and possibly also urinals) which is available for use by the general public, or by customers or employees of certain businesses.

concepts.label: PublicationEvent
concepts.description: A PublicationEvent corresponds indifferently to the event of publication for a CreativeWork of any type, e.g. a broadcast event, an on-demand event, a book/journal publication via a variety of delivery media.

concepts.label: PublicationIssue
concepts.description: A part of a successively published publication such as a periodical or publication volume, often numbered, usually containing a grouping of works such as articles.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog-schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

concepts.label: PublicationVolume
concepts.description: A part of a successively published publication such as a periodical or multi-volume work, often numbered. It may represent a time span, such as a year.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog-schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

concepts.label: PurchaseType
concepts.description: Enumerates a purchase type for an item.

concepts.label: QAPage
concepts.description: A QAPage is a WebPage focussed on a specific Question and its Answer(s), e.g. in a question answering site or documenting Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs).

concepts.label: QualitativeValue
concepts.description: A predefined value for a product characteristic, e.g. the power cord plug type 'US' or the garment sizes 'S', 'M', 'L', and 'XL'.

concepts.label: QuantitativeValue
concepts.description: A point value or interval for product characteristics and other purposes.

concepts.label: QuantitativeValueDistribution
concepts.description: A statistical distribution of values.

concepts.label: Question
concepts.description: A specific question - e.g. from a user seeking answers online, or collected in a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) document.

concepts.label: Quiz
concepts.description: Quiz: A test of knowledge, skills and abilities.

concepts.label: Quotation
concepts.description: A quotation. Often but not necessarily from some written work, attributable to a real world author and - if associated with a fictional character - to any fictional Person. Use [[isBasedOn]] to link to source/origin. The [[recordedIn]] property can be used to reference a Quotation from an [[Event]].

concepts.label: RVPark
concepts.description: A place offering space for "Recreational Vehicles", Caravans, mobile homes and the like.

concepts.label: RadioChannel
concepts.description: A unique instance of a radio BroadcastService on a CableOrSatelliteService lineup.

concepts.label: RadioClip
concepts.description: A short radio program or a segment/part of a radio program.

concepts.label: RadioEpisode
concepts.description: A radio episode which can be part of a series or season.

concepts.label: RadioSeason
concepts.description: Season dedicated to radio broadcast and associated online delivery.

concepts.label: RadioSeries
concepts.description: CreativeWorkSeries dedicated to radio broadcast and associated online delivery.

concepts.label: RadioStation
concepts.description: A radio station.

concepts.label: Rating
concepts.description: A rating is an evaluation on a numeric scale, such as 1 to 5 stars.

concepts.label: ReactAction
concepts.description: The act of responding instinctively and emotionally to an object, expressing a sentiment.

concepts.label: ReadAction
concepts.description: The act of consuming written content.

concepts.label: RealEstateAgent
concepts.description: A real-estate agent.

concepts.label: RealEstateListing
concepts.description:
A [[RealEstateListing]] is a listing that describes one or more real-estate [[Offer]]s (whose [[businessFunction]] is typically to lease out, or to sell).
  The [[RealEstateListing]] type itself represents the overall listing, as manifested in some [[WebPage]].

concepts.label: Recipe
concepts.description: A recipe. For dietary restrictions covered by the recipe, a few common restrictions are enumerated via [[suitableForDiet]]. The [[keywords]] property can also be used to add more detail.

concepts.label: Recommendation
concepts.description: [[Recommendation]] is a type of [[Review]] that suggests or proposes something as the best option or best course of action. Recommendations may be for products or services, or other concrete things, as in the case of a ranked list or product guide. A [[Guide]] may list multiple recommendations for different categories. For example, in a [[Guide]] about which TVs to buy, the author may have several [[Recommendation]]s.

concepts.label: RecyclingCenter
concepts.description: A recycling center.

concepts.label: RefundTypeEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerates several kinds of product return refund types.

concepts.label: RegisterAction
concepts.description:
The act of registering to be a user of a service, product or web page.

Related actions:

* [[JoinAction]]: Unlike JoinAction, RegisterAction implies you are registering to be a user of a service, *not* a group/team of people.
* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, RegisterAction doesn't imply that the agent is expecting to poll for updates from the object.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, RegisterAction doesn't imply that the agent is expecting updates from the object.

concepts.label: RepaymentSpecification
concepts.description: A structured value representing repayment.

concepts.label: Report
concepts.description: A Report generated by governmental or non-governmental organization.

concepts.label: ReportageNewsArticle
concepts.description:
The [[ReportageNewsArticle]] type is a subtype of [[NewsArticle]] representing
 news articles which are the result of journalistic news reporting conventions.

In practice many news publishers produce a wide variety of article types, many of which might be considered a [[NewsArticle]] but not a [[ReportageNewsArticle]]. For example, opinion pieces, reviews, analysis, sponsored or satirical articles, or articles that combine several of these elements.

The [[ReportageNewsArticle]] type is based on a stricter ideal for "news" as a work of journalism, with articles based on factual information either observed or verified by the author, or reported and verified from knowledgeable sources.  This often includes perspectives from multiple viewpoints on a particular issue (distinguishing news reports from public relations or propaganda).  News reports in the [[ReportageNewsArticle]] sense de-emphasize the opinion of the author, with commentary and value judgements typically expressed elsewhere.

A [[ReportageNewsArticle]] which goes deeper into analysis can also be marked with an additional type of [[AnalysisNewsArticle]].

concepts.label: ResearchOrganization
concepts.description: A Research Organization (e.g. scientific institute, research company).

concepts.label: ResearchProject
concepts.description: A Research project.

concepts.label: Researcher
concepts.description: Researchers.

concepts.label: Reservation
concepts.description: Describes a reservation for travel, dining or an event. Some reservations require tickets. \n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, restaurant reservations, flights, or rental cars, use [[Offer]].

concepts.label: ReservationPackage
concepts.description: A group of multiple reservations with common values for all sub-reservations.

concepts.label: ReserveAction
concepts.description:
Reserving a concrete object.

Related actions:

* [[ScheduleAction]]: Unlike ScheduleAction, ReserveAction reserves concrete objects (e.g. a table, a hotel) towards a time slot / spatial allocation.

concepts.label: ResetPasswordAction
concepts.description: The action of resetting the password of a device or application.

concepts.label: Residence
concepts.description: The place where a person lives.

concepts.label: Resort
concepts.description:
A resort is a place used for relaxation or recreation, attracting visitors for holidays or vacations. Resorts are places, towns or sometimes commercial establishments operated by a single company (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Resort).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

concepts.label: Restaurant
concepts.description: A restaurant.

concepts.label: RestrictedDiet
concepts.description: A diet restricted to certain foods or preparations for cultural, religious, health or lifestyle reasons.

concepts.label: ResumeAction
concepts.description: The act of resuming a device or application which was formerly paused (e.g. resume music playback or resume a timer).

concepts.label: ReturnFeesEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerates several kinds of policies for product return fees.

concepts.label: ReturnLabelSourceEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerates several types of return labels for product returns.

concepts.label: ReturnMethodEnumeration
concepts.description: Enumerates several types of product return methods.

concepts.label: Review
concepts.description: A review of an item - for example, of a restaurant, movie, or store.

concepts.label: ReviewAction
concepts.description: The act of producing a balanced opinion about the object for an audience. An agent reviews an object with participants resulting in a review.

concepts.label: ReviewNewsArticle
concepts.description: A [[NewsArticle]] and [[CriticReview]] providing a professional critic's assessment of a service, product, performance, or artistic or literary work.

concepts.label: Role
concepts.description: Represents additional information about a relationship or property. For example a Role can be used to say that a 'member' role linking some SportsTeam to a player occurred during a particular time period. Or that a Person's 'actor' role in a Movie was for some particular characterName. Such properties can be attached to a Role entity, which is then associated with the main entities using ordinary properties like 'member' or 'actor'.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/06/16/introducing-role/).

concepts.label: RoofingContractor
concepts.description: A roofing contractor.

concepts.label: Room
concepts.description:
A room is a distinguishable space within a structure, usually separated from other spaces by interior walls (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Room).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

concepts.label: RsvpResponseType
concepts.description: RsvpResponseType is an enumeration type whose instances represent responding to an RSVP request.

concepts.label: RuntimePlatform
concepts.description: Specialized software environment that provides the essential infrastructure, libraries, and services required to execute a program.

concepts.label: SaleEvent
concepts.description: Event type: Sales event.

concepts.label: SatiricalArticle
